sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片打碟的年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着你最珍视的300件宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，展示着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Back-to-back hearings that ended on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 周四结束了背靠背的听证会。

sentences.en: Pete Hegseth went before Congress for the first time in a year to answer for a war in Iran that's reached a stalemate and a management style that has caused controversy after controversy at the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 皮特·赫格塞斯一年来首次出席国会听证，就陷入僵局的伊朗战争以及他在五角大楼引发一连串争议的管理风格进行答辩。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Eric Schmidt takes us inside his testimony.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事埃里克·施密特将带我们深入了解他的证词。

sentences.en: Friday, May 1St.
sentences.zh: 5月1日，星期五。

sentences.en: Always a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 总是很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us.
sentences.zh: 感谢你加入我们。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Let me start by asking, as a reporter who covers the military and the Pentagon and the war in Iran,
sentences.zh: 让我先问一下，作为一名报道军事、五角大楼和伊朗战争的记者，

sentences.en: how were you thinking about this hearing before the Senate Armed Services Committee as it was about to begin on Thursday morning?
sentences.zh: 在周四上午参议院军事委员会听证会即将开始时，你是如何看待这场听证会的？

sentences.en: What in your mind were the stakes of Pete Hegseth, the defense secretary, giving this testimony at this particular moment?
sentences.zh: 在你看来，国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯在此时此地作证，其利害关系是什么？

sentences.en: So the stakes really couldn't have been larger, Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，利害关系确实再大不过了。

sentences.en: Once a year, the secretary of defense and the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff come up to Congress and testify.
sentences.zh: 每年，国防部长和参谋长联席会议主席都会到国会作证。

sentences.en: Basically, they're asking for money.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们是在要钱。

sentences.en: They want to get their budget approved.
sentences.zh: 他们希望预算获得批准。

sentences.en: And this year's budget is a biggie.
sentences.zh: 而今年的预算是个大头。

sentences.en: It's almost $1.5 trillion, the largest budget request ever, some $500 million more than this year's budget.
sentences.zh: 高达近1.5万亿美元，是有史以来最大的预算申请，比今年的预算多出约5000亿美元。

sentences.en: And this is to do everything from replenish munitions stockpiles, to rebuild the Navy, to construct a new anti-missile system called Golden Dome.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱将用于从补充弹药储备、重建海军，到建造名为“金穹”的新型反导系统等各项事务。

sentences.en: So this is all kind of part and parcel of this budget requeSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这些都是这项预算申请的一部分。

sentences.en: But remember, it's been a year since he's had to testify before Congress, and there's been so many things that have happened in that year.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，他已经有一年没有在国会作证了，而这一年里发生了太多事情。

sentences.en: The military has seized the leader of Venezuela and brought him to the United States.
sentences.zh: 军方抓获了委内瑞拉领导人并将其带到了美国。

sentences.en: He's fired dozens of generals and admirals, many of them women and minorities, that he didn't think cut muster in his Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 他解雇了数十名将军和海军上将，其中许多是女性和少数族裔，因为他认为他们不符合他五角大楼的要求。

sentences.en: And it's also landing.
sentences.zh: 而且它也正在落地。

sentences.en: It's a very important time because obviously we're two months into the Iran war.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重要的时刻，因为显然我们已经进入伊朗战争两个月了。

sentences.en: Of course, he's also kicked reporters out of the Pentagon, so he doesn't really have real news conferences anymore.
sentences.zh: 当然，他还把记者赶出了五角大楼，所以他现在基本上不再举行真正的新闻发布会了。

sentences.en: So there has been very little public accountability for a wide range of kind of operational and programmatic and budget issues that he has done.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于他所采取的广泛的行动、项目和预算问题，公众几乎没有任何问责。

sentences.en: They've been very controversial.
sentences.zh: 这些问题一直极具争议。

sentences.en: And he just hasn't really had to answer this.
sentences.zh: 而他一直没有真正需要对此做出回应。

sentences.en: And this would be the first time where he's going to have to face pointed questions from congressional Democrats and some Republicans who have questioned what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 这将是他第一次不得不面对国会民主党人以及一些质疑他所作所为的共和党人的尖锐提问。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So on its face, this is a perfunctory budget hearing, and the budget request is huge, but, you know, it's annual.
sentences.zh: 所以表面上看，这是一场例行的预算听证会，预算申请数额巨大，但你知道，这是年度性的。

sentences.en: But you're saying what this is really about is that for the first time, the Secretary of Defense, arguably the most controversial Secretary of Defense in our lifetime,
sentences.zh: 但你的意思是，这实际上是因为国防部长——可以说是有史以来最具争议的国防部长——第一次，

sentences.en: is going to be challenged and held accountable under oath for all the things that he has done since pretty much he was confirmed to the job.
sentences.zh: 将要被挑战，并就他自确认担任该职位以来所做的一切事情宣誓接受问责。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, with that in mind, take us into this hearing room on Thursday morning and set that scene.
sentences.zh: 那么，考虑到这一点，带我们进入周四上午的听证会现场，描述一下当时的场景。

sentences.en: We are meeting today to review the Pentagon's FY27 budget requeSt.
sentences.zh: 我们今天开会是为了审查五角大楼2027财年的预算申请。

sentences.en: So Hankseth is seated facing this array of senators.
sentences.zh: 赫格塞斯坐在那里，面对着一众参议员。

sentences.en: Well, Mr. Chairman, Ranking Member Reed, Senators, thank you for the opportunity to testify in support of President Trump's historic, as you said, Mr. Chairman,
sentences.zh: 主席先生，瑞德首席议员，各位参议员，感谢你们给我机会，支持特朗普总统正如你所说，主席先生，

sentences.en: $1.5 trillion fiscal year 2027 budget for the Department of War.
sentences.zh: 为战争部提出的1.5万亿美元的2027财年预算。

sentences.en: And he starts by making his case for why they should be giving him and the Department of Defense such a large budget.
sentences.zh: 他首先陈述了为什么他们应该给他和国防部如此庞大的预算。

sentences.en: The president's budget request reflects the urgency of the moment,
sentences.zh: 总统的预算申请反映了当下的紧迫性，

sentences.en: addressing both the deferment of longstanding problems as well as positioning our forces for the current and future fights.
sentences.zh: 既解决了长期问题的拖延，也为我们部队应对当前和未来的战斗做好了准备。

sentences.en: But then he turns and he starts to address the big issue in the room, of course, which is the Iran war.
sentences.zh: 但随后他转过身，开始谈论房间里的大问题，当然，那就是伊朗战争。

sentences.en: President Trump has the courage, has had, unlike other presidents, to ensure that Iran never gets a nuclear weapon and that their nuclear blackmail never succeeds.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统有勇气，不像其他总统那样，确保伊朗永远不会获得核武器，确保他们的核讹诈永远不会得逞。

sentences.en: And he also talks about what is really the adversary here.
sentences.zh: 他还谈到了谁才是真正的对手。

sentences.en: The biggest adversary we face at this point are the reckless naysayers and defeatist words of congressional Democrats and some Republicans.
sentences.zh: 我们目前面临的最大对手是国会民主党人和一些共和党人鲁莽的反对者和失败主义言论。

sentences.en: Basically calling congressional Democrats and some Republicans defeatist for criticizing the military's campaign and President Trump's overall effort in Iran after just two short months.
sentences.zh: 基本上是称国会民主党人和一些共和党人为失败主义者，因为他们在短短两个月后就批评军方的行动和特朗普总统在伊朗的整体努力。

sentences.en: Defeatists from the cheap seats who, two months in,
sentences.zh: 那些坐在廉价座位上的失败主义者，在两个月后，

sentences.en: seek to undermine the incredible efforts that have been undertaken and the historic nature of taking on a 47-year threat with the courage no other president has had.
sentences.zh: 试图破坏已经采取的令人难以置信的努力，以及以其他总统所没有的勇气去应对一个47年威胁的历史性意义。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it says that they are a greater enemy in this moment than Iran itself.
sentences.zh: 他说他们此刻比伊朗本身更危险。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Basically, the adversary here is at home.
sentences.zh: 基本上，对手就在国内。

sentences.en: And why can't you see Democrats and even some negative Republicans, why can't you see what a great job the military has done?
sentences.zh: 为什么你们看不到民主党人，甚至一些消极的共和党人，为什么你们看不到军方做得有多好？

sentences.en: And this is the only president bold enough to take on such a threat.
sentences.zh: 这是唯一一位有胆量应对这种威胁的总统。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this essentially serves as a pre-bottal to any tough questions he's going to get about this war in this hearing.
sentences.zh: 这本质上是对他在这次听证会上将要面对的任何尖锐问题的预先反驳。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But the tough questions from Republicans never really come.
sentences.zh: 但共和党人的尖锐问题从未真正出现。

sentences.en: Their statements are more of tremendous support for this budget that's long overdue.
sentences.zh: 他们的发言更多是对这项姗姗来迟的预算的极大支持。

sentences.en: This $1.5 trillion request is chock full of important programs and initiatives that are absolutely necessary.
sentences.zh: 这份1.5万亿美元的申请中充满了绝对必要的重要项目和倡议。

sentences.en: They can't believe what a terrific secretary Hexeth is and how great a job he's been doing over these last several months.
sentences.zh: 他们简直不敢相信赫格塞斯部长是多么出色，过去几个月他做得有多好。

sentences.en: I want to turn now to Operation Epic Fury.
sentences.zh: 我现在想谈谈“史诗之怒”行动。

sentences.en: It's been a smashing military success.
sentences.zh: 这是一次巨大的军事成功。

sentences.en: They praised his conduct in the war in Iran.
sentences.zh: 他们称赞他在伊朗战争中的表现。

sentences.en: They praised the operation that snatched President Maduro from Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 他们称赞了从委内瑞拉抓获马杜罗总统的行动。

sentences.en: You're the best that we've had since I've been in Washington, what you've done to restore readiness.
sentences.zh: 你是我在华盛顿期间见过的最棒的，你在恢复战备方面所做的一切。

sentences.en: A whole raft of things that just show they believe the Pentagon is in the best hands possible.
sentences.zh: 一大堆事情都表明他们相信五角大楼掌握在最好的手中。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，主席先生。

sentences.en: Secretary Hexeth, you're doing a great job.
sentences.zh: 赫格塞斯部长，你做得很好。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Their message is quite simply, you're great.
sentences.zh: 他们的信息很简单：你很棒。

sentences.en: The war in Iran is going pretty great.
sentences.zh: 伊朗战争进行得相当不错。

sentences.en: And that stands out, at least to me, because congressional Republicans have not avoided asking the rest of Trump's cabinet pretty tough questions in hearings.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说很突出，因为国会共和党人在听证会上并没有回避向特朗普内阁的其他成员提出非常尖锐的问题。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about the pointed inquiries directed at Kristi Noem, the Homeland Security Secretary, or former Attorney General Pam Bondi.
sentences.zh: 我想到的是针对国土安全部长克里斯蒂·诺姆或前司法部长帕姆·邦迪的尖锐质询。

sentences.en: In fact, those hearings led in part to their ouster by President Trump.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这些听证会在一定程度上导致了他们被特朗普总统解职。

sentences.en: But on arguably the most urgent topic of the second term, the war, its fallout, they really fall in line.
sentences.zh: 但在第二任期可以说最紧迫的话题——战争及其后果上，他们真的保持了一致。

sentences.en: They really do.
sentences.zh: 他们确实如此。

sentences.en: You don't hear any criticism about the war in Iran or pretty much anything else.
sentences.zh: 你听不到任何关于伊朗战争或其他任何事情的批评。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But that was not the story of Democrats on this committee, quite obviously.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，委员会里的民主党人并不是这样。

sentences.en: No, the Democrats came loaded for bear.
sentences.zh: 不，民主党人是有备而来的。

sentences.en: Mr. Secretary, this war is stuck.
sentences.zh: 部长先生，这场战争陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: They come after Hexeth and just saying, look, the United States has not met its goals here.
sentences.zh: 他们追着赫格塞斯说，看，美国在这里没有实现其目标。

sentences.en: Iran's hotline regime remains in place.
sentences.zh: 伊朗的政权依然存在。

sentences.en: The Iranians still have highly enriched uranium.
sentences.zh: 伊朗人仍然拥有高浓缩铀。

sentences.en: They still have thousands of missiles and drones.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然拥有数以千计的导弹和无人机。

sentences.en: And most important, the Strait of Hormuz is closed.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，霍尔木兹海峡被封锁了。

sentences.en: They also are controlling the Strait of Hormuz and choking off the economy for the globe.
sentences.zh: 他们还在控制霍尔木兹海峡，切断了全球经济。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This illegal war is driving up costs, undermining readiness and alienating our allies.
sentences.zh: 这场非法战争正在推高成本，破坏战备状态，并疏远我们的盟友。

sentences.en: And then there are a number of other Senate Democrats, including Kirsten Gillibrand of New York, who say to Hexeth, you are so out of touch.
sentences.zh: 还有许多其他参议院民主党人，包括纽约州的克里斯汀·吉利布兰德，他们对赫格塞斯说，你太脱离群众了。

sentences.en: I don't know if you fully appreciate how much the American people do not support this war.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否充分意识到美国人民有多么不支持这场战争。

sentences.en: But you have no idea how unpopular this war is with my constituents back home.
sentences.zh: 你根本不知道这场战争在我的选民中有多么不受欢迎。

sentences.en: First of all, this war is costing so much money.
sentences.zh: 首先，这场战争花费了太多钱。

sentences.en: Over $25 billion already, estimates $1 billion a day.
sentences.zh: 已经超过250亿美元，估计每天10亿美元。

sentences.en: And they're feeling it every single day at the gas pump with higher prices for both fuel, for diesel, for gasoline, for their cars.
sentences.zh: 他们每天都在加油站感受到这一点，因为汽车燃料、柴油和汽油的价格更高了。

sentences.en: They're also feeling it with higher grocery costs.
sentences.zh: 他们也在更高的食品杂货成本中感受到了这一点。

sentences.en: And they're exhausted.
sentences.zh: 而且他们精疲力竭。

sentences.en: They are truly exhausted.
sentences.zh: 他们真的精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: And that this is just a war with no seeming end, with no real upside to it, as far as her constituents can tell.
sentences.zh: 而且就她的选民所知，这只是一场似乎没有尽头、没有任何真正好处的战争。

sentences.en: And you don't seem to know what you're doing.
sentences.zh: 而且你似乎不知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: Why do you continue to prosecute a war that the American people aren't behind?
sentences.zh: 为什么你还要继续进行一场美国人民不支持的战争？

sentences.en: Hexeth pushes back against these critics.
sentences.zh: 赫格塞斯反驳了这些批评者。

sentences.en: And Senator, when I talk to Americans, and especially when I talk to the troops,
sentences.zh: 参议员，当我与美国人交谈时，尤其是当我与部队交谈时，

sentences.en: they are grateful for a president who has the courage to take on this threat after 47 years of what Iran has done.
sentences.zh: 他们感谢一位有勇气的总统，在伊朗做了47年的事情之后，敢于应对这种威胁。

sentences.en: Basically saying that there's really no price you can put on the security that President Trump's campaign against Iran is going to provide.
sentences.zh: 基本上是说，特朗普总统针对伊朗的行动所提供的安全保障是无价的。

sentences.en: So the question I would ask to you and to others is, what is the cost of a nuclear-armed Iran?
sentences.zh: 所以我问你和其他人的问题是，一个拥有核武器的伊朗代价是什么？

sentences.en: What is the cost to the American people if the world's most dangerous regime has a nuclear weapon?
sentences.zh: 如果世界上最危险的政权拥有核武器，对美国人民的代价是什么？

sentences.en: There's no price on that.
sentences.zh: 那是无价的。

sentences.en: That long-term security that has eluded president after president, Republicans and Democrats for decades, is now within our grasp.
sentences.zh: 那种几十年来让历任总统（无论是共和党还是民主党）都难以企及的长期安全，现在就在我们掌握之中。

sentences.en: That is what Hexeth is saying.
sentences.zh: 这就是赫格塞斯所说的。

sentences.en: And yes, there may be some short-term economic costs, but the long-term security that it buys is immeasurable.
sentences.zh: 是的，可能会有一些短期的经济成本，但它所带来的长期安全是不可估量的。

sentences.en: This is a defined mission set that we have had great success in pursuing against a determined enemy who seeks nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 这是一个明确的任务集，我们在追求这一目标方面取得了巨大成功，对抗的是一个寻求核武器的顽固敌人。

sentences.en: And I'm proud of the opportunity to remind the American people, because they believe in it as well, that they can't have it.
sentences.zh: 我很自豪有机会提醒美国人民，因为他们也相信这一点，他们不能拥有它。

sentences.en: You don't care whether the American people support this war.
sentences.zh: 你根本不在乎美国人民是否支持这场战争。

sentences.en: But the American people are quite smart.
sentences.zh: 但美国人民非常聪明。

sentences.en: They understand and see through spin.
sentences.zh: 他们理解并看穿了这种说辞。

sentences.en: They know that a regime that says death to America, that seeks nuclear weapons, and the ability to deliver—
sentences.zh: 他们知道一个高喊“打倒美国”、寻求核武器及其投送能力的政权——

sentences.en: I'm curious, Eric, what else stood out to you about how these Senate Democrats talked to Hexeth about the war in Iran?
sentences.zh: 埃里克，我很好奇，关于参议院民主党人如何与赫格塞斯谈论伊朗战争，还有什么让你印象深刻的？

sentences.en: Well, the big issue for Democrats, and they kept asking about it, was how long will this war last, and will you ever come to us here on Capitol Hill for authorization?
sentences.zh: 嗯，民主党人的大问题，也是他们一直追问的问题，是这场战争会持续多久，你是否会来国会山寻求授权？

sentences.en: There's a big debate going on right now, because as of Friday, there's a 60-day limit from the start of hostilities,
sentences.zh: 现在正在进行一场激烈的辩论，因为截至周五，敌对行动开始后有60天的限制，

sentences.zh: 在这里没有中间地带，我们无法在这些问题上求同存异。

sentences.en: And he is definitely in the camp of either with us or you're against us.
sentences.zh: 你一直在重复这个短语。

sentences.en: There's no gray area in the middle here where we can agree to disagree on these kind of issues.
sentences.zh: 这出现在他与内华达州民主党参议员杰基·罗森的交流中，她问赫格塞斯为什么使用这个词。

sentences.en: You keep doubling down on this phrase.
sentences.zh: 你把记者比作法利赛人，你把我们比作法利赛人，你把很多人比作法利赛人。

sentences.en: And this comes up in an exchange with Jackie Rosen, a Democrat from Nevada, who is asking Hegseth of why he uses a term.
sentences.zh: 《新约》中的法利赛人，他们批评拿撒勒人耶稣行神迹。

sentences.en: You compare journalists, you compare us, you compare so many to Pharisees.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有问题且在历史上被武器化的词汇，将犹太社区描绘成虚伪或道德败坏的群体。

sentences.en: Pharisees in the New Testament, who criticize Jesus of Nazareth for performing miracles.
sentences.zh: 你再次加码并说了这个词。

sentences.en: It's a problematic and historically weaponized term that casts Jewish communities as hypocritical or morally corrupt.
sentences.zh: 她对此感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: You doubled down again and said it.
sentences.zh: 作为国防部长，你如何证明使用这种语言的合理性？

sentences.en: And she's just taken aback by this.
sentences.zh: 这有什么关系吗？

sentences.en: How do you justify using this language as secretary of defense?
sentences.zh: 这是一个伤人的、历史上具有伤害性的词。

sentences.en: Where does it matter?
sentences.zh: 参议员，我觉得对于那些看不到自己眼中有梁木，却总是想挑剔行动有什么问题的人来说，这是一个相当准确的词，

sentences.en: It's a hurt, historically hurtful term.
sentences.zh: 而不是去关注阻止伊朗获得核武器的历史性成功。

sentences.en: Senator, I feel like it's a pretty accurate term for folks who don't see the plank in their own eye and always want to see what's wrong with an operation
sentences.zh: 所以我坚持我的说法。

sentences.en: as opposed to the historic success of preventing Iran from getting a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 你坚持称呼人们为法利赛人。

sentences.en: So I stand by it.
sentences.zh: 先生，我不能，我不能容忍这一点。

sentences.en: You stand by calling people Pharisees.
sentences.zh: 这是错误的。

sentences.en: Sir, I cannot, I cannot stand for that.
sentences.zh: 这对人们是不尊重的。

sentences.en: That is wrong.
sentences.zh: 我期望我们国家的任何领导人都能尊重他人，使用尊重的词汇，而不是成为反犹主义者。

sentences.en: It is not respectful to people.
sentences.zh: 这又回到了他在听证会开始时发表的评论，他称伊朗行动的批评者为

sentences.en: And I expect anyone who is in leadership in our country to be respectful and use respectful terms and not be an anti-Semite.
sentences.zh: 鲁莽的反对者和失败主义者。

sentences.en: And it kind of circles back to the comments he made at the beginning of the hearing where he talks about critics of the Iran campaign
sentences.zh: 同样，对于这类事情，似乎没有任何进行理性辩论的空间。

sentences.en: as reckless naysayers and defeatists.
sentences.zh: 今天的听证会到此结束。

sentences.en: And again, there seems to be no room for an intellectual argument over this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢我们的证人提供的证词。

sentences.en: This concludes today's hearing.
sentences.zh: 告知各位委员，记录在案的问题需在听证会结束后两个工作日内提交给委员会。

sentences.en: I'd like to thank our witnesses for their testimony.
sentences.zh: 休会。

sentences.en: For the information of members, questions for the record would be due to the committee within two business days of the conclusion of the hearing.
sentences.zh: 作为一个报道国防部长已有35年的人，这非常引人注目，我报道过像唐纳德·拉姆斯菲尔德那样好斗的部长。

sentences.en: We are adjourned.
sentences.zh: 但他们从未被塑造成媒体或国会是彻头彻尾的敌人的形象。

sentences.en: It's very striking as somebody,
sentences.zh: 如果你站在本届政府或五角大楼的对立面，或者挑战赫格塞斯部长个人，他是不会退缩的。

sentences.en: I've covered defense secretaries now for 35 years, combative ones like Donald Rumsfeld.
sentences.zh: 事实上，看起来你现在已经在他的敌人名单上了。

sentences.en: But it was never cast in the sense of the media or the Congress is an outright enemy.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If you're coming down on the wrong side of this administration or this Pentagon or challenging Secretary Hegseth personally, he's not going to back down.
sentences.zh: 甚至向他提出某种问题，就会被视为等同于伊朗本身的敌人。

sentences.en: And in fact, you're now on his enemies list, it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 这又是另一个观点，在民主党人看来，这恰恰表明了本届政府在发动这场战争时是多么草率。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 他们以为这场战争很快就会结束，甚至根本不需要担心那个60天的期限。

sentences.en: And to even ask a certain kind of question to him is to be an enemy akin to Iran itself.
sentences.zh: 我们永远不会触及这个期限，因为伊朗政权会倒台，一切都会顺利解决。

sentences.en: That seems to be the way he sees things.
sentences.zh: 他似乎就是这样看待事物的。

sentences.en: And it's all done with kind of, he looks at lawmakers who ask these questions very suspiciously, oftentimes with kind of a smile on his face,
sentences.zh: 而且他做这一切时，总是带着某种神情，他会用非常怀疑的目光审视那些提出问题的议员，脸上往往还挂着一丝微笑，

sentences.en: like, ah, this game that we're in here.
sentences.zh: 仿佛在说，呵，我们现在玩的这一套把戏。

sentences.en: And there's very little deference that you normally see at these kind of hearings where they kind of bite their tongue and say, yes, Senator, yes, Congressman, and move on.
sentences.zh: 在这种听证会上，你通常看不到那种应有的尊重，那种人们通常会咬紧牙关，客气地说“是的，参议员”、“是的，众议员”，然后继续进行下去的态度。

sentences.en: It's just, it's very confrontational, as we've seen with other members of the Trump cabinet.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在特朗普内阁其他成员身上看到的那样，他表现得非常具有对抗性。

sentences.en: And there's a kind of irony to this, which you know very well, Eric, because we've talked to you about it from the moment that Hegseth was nominated for this job
sentences.zh: 这其中有一种讽刺意味，埃里克，你对此非常清楚，因为从赫格塞斯被提名担任这个职位的那一刻起，

sentences.en: and through his confirmation hearings.
sentences.zh: 以及在整个确认听证会期间，我们就一直和你讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: Pete Hegseth's appeal to President Trump and in theory to folks in the Pentagon when he was nominated was his unusual willingness to criticize previous military leaders,
sentences.zh: 皮特·赫格塞斯之所以能吸引特朗普总统，理论上也能吸引五角大楼的人，是因为他有一种不同寻常的意愿，敢于批评以前的军事领导人，

sentences.en: to say that past folks who occupied the same seat he now does had blown it, that they had gotten America in bad wars, forever wars,
sentences.zh: 敢于说过去坐在他现在这个位置上的人搞砸了，说他们把美国拖入了糟糕的战争，无休止的战争，

sentences.en: that they had ruined the culture of the military.
sentences.zh: 说他们毁了军队的文化。

sentences.en: And now he has that job.
sentences.zh: 而现在，他自己担任了这个职位。

sentences.en: And as hearings like this demonstrate,
sentences.zh: 正如这样的听证会所展示的那样，

sentences.en: he is not willing to endure the kind of criticism that he so forcefully delivered and that in large part may be responsible for why he now has the job.
sentences.zh: 他自己却无法忍受那种他曾强力施加于人的批评，而这种批评在很大程度上可能正是他如今能得到这份工作的原因。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: In many ways, he captured President Trump's attention as a Fox News host for criticizing the very senior military leaders who he once served
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，他作为福克斯新闻的主持人吸引了特朗普总统的注意，正是因为他批评了那些他曾经作为军官，

sentences.en: as an officer in both Afghanistan and Iraq.
sentences.zh: 在阿富汗和伊拉克服役时所效忠的高级军事领导人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And basically saying, I am part of this generation of men and women who served in the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan and I know the mistakes that were made.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在说，我是这一代在伊拉克和阿富汗战争中服役的男女军人中的一员，我知道过去犯下的错误。

sentences.en: I live them day in, day out.
sentences.zh: 我日复一日地亲历着这些错误。

sentences.en: And I've come back to fix them and to correct them.
sentences.zh: 我回来就是为了修复和纠正它们。

sentences.en: And with President Trump imprimatur, we're well on our way of doing that.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统的认可下，我们正在顺利实现这一目标。

sentences.en: But I think what the hearings this week showed was that at least in the secretary's telling, he can never be wrong.
sentences.zh: 但我认为本周的听证会表明，至少在部长本人的叙述中，他永远不会犯错。

sentences.en: He can never be challenged the way he challenged civilian and uniformed leaders in years paSt.
sentences.zh: 他绝不能像他过去挑战文职和军方领导人那样受到挑战。

sentences.en: And anyone who challenges that needs to be taken down.
sentences.zh: 任何挑战他的人都必须被击倒。

sentences.en: Well, Eric.
sentences.zh: 好的，埃里克。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the House of Representatives voted to end a record 76-day shutdown of the Department of Homeland Security.
sentences.zh: 周四，众议院投票结束了国土安全部创纪录的76天停摆。

sentences.en: After weeks of fighting over a compromise bill,
sentences.zh: 在经过数周关于妥协法案的争斗后，

sentences.en: House Republicans endorsed legislation that will fund all of the agency except for its immigration enforcement operations.
sentences.zh: 众议院共和党人批准了一项法案，该法案将为该机构除移民执法行动外的所有部门提供资金。

sentences.en: Those operations will be funded through separate legislation.
sentences.zh: 这些行动将通过单独的立法来提供资金。

sentences.en: The shutdown began as an act of protest by Democrats over the Trump administration's crackdown on illegal immigration, which resulted in the death of two American citizens.
sentences.zh: 此次停摆始于民主党人对特朗普政府打击非法移民政策的抗议，该政策导致了两名美国公民的死亡。

sentences.en: And in a major blow to the Democratic Party leaders who backed her,
sentences.zh: 这对支持她的民主党领袖来说是一个重大打击，

sentences.en: Maine's governor, Janet Mills, has ended her primary campaign for U.S.
sentences.zh: 缅因州州长珍妮特·米尔斯结束了她的美国参议院初选竞选，

sentences.en: Senate, conceding that she no longer has the money or the momentum to compete against a progressive newcomer,
sentences.zh: 承认她已没有足够的资金或势头来与一位进步派新人竞争，

sentences.en: Graham Plattner.
sentences.zh: 即格雷厄姆·普拉特纳。

sentences.en: Her exit paves the way for Plattner to become the Democratic nominee against Republican Susan Collins in a race that Democrats must win to regain control of the Senate
sentences.zh: 她的退出为普拉特纳扫清了障碍，使其成为民主党候选人，将在今年中期选举中与共和党人苏珊·柯林斯展开角逐，民主党必须赢得这场竞选才能重新获得参议院的控制权。

sentences.en: in this year's midterMs.
sentences.zh: 在今年的中期选举中。

sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
